issues.t: Cylinder head oil plug may leak and start a fire (recall)
issues.sym: Oil smell, smoke from under the hood, or oil on the exhaust manifold.
issues.why: A plug in the cylinder head oil passage might not seal, letting oil seep onto hot engine parts. Chrysler recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls. If you see smoke or smell burning oil, stop and have the engine inspected before driving again.

issues.t: Fuel system leak and vapor recalls
issues.sym: Fuel smell around the van, especially after filling up or near the fuel tank.
issues.why: Several 1996 campaigns covered fuel risks: a static charge at the filler tube that could ignite vapors, a rollover valve that let fuel into the vapor canister, and a loose fuel pump module nut that could leak.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls. Any fuel smell is a fire risk, so park the van and have it inspected.

issues.t: Rear bench seat bolts can break (recall)
issues.sym: Rear bench seat feels loose or rattles in its mounts.
issues.why: Bolts holding the rear bench could become brittle and fracture, so the seat may not stay anchored in a crash. Chrysler recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and do not carry passengers on a loose seat until it is repaired.

issues.t: Built-in child seat problems (recalls)
issues.sym: Built-in child seat harness is hard to release, the buckle does not slide freely, or the harness looks routed wrong.
issues.why: The integrated child seats in these vans were covered by several campaigns for broken mounting bolts, hard-to-release harnesses and incorrectly routed webbing.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls before using the built-in child seats.

issues.t: Clock spring can disable the driver airbag (recalls)
issues.sym: Airbag warning light stays on, and the horn or cruise buttons may stop working.
issues.why: The clock spring in the steering wheel, which carries power to the airbag, could be wound wrong at the factory or fail with use. Chrysler recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and have the clock spring replaced promptly, since the airbag may not deploy.

issues.t: Fuel rail O-rings can leak (recall)
issues.sym: Gasoline smell under the hood, or fuel wetness around the injectors.
issues.why: Rubber O-rings on the fuel rail could break down and let fuel seep out near hot engine parts. Chrysler recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls. Do not drive with a fuel smell until it is inspected.

issues.t: Brake master cylinder seal can leak (recall)
issues.sym: Brake pedal sinks lower than normal, the brake warning light comes on, or fluid level drops.
issues.why: A rear seal in the master cylinder could leak brake fluid into the brake booster vacuum reservoir. Chrysler recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls. A sinking pedal or brake warning light means stop driving and have it towed.

issues.t: Four-speed automatic slipping, no reverse or stuck in one gear
issues.sym: Slipping, harsh or delayed shifts, no reverse, or the van staying in second or third gear with weak acceleration.
issues.why: The four-speed automatic in these vans has a long record of internal wear and solenoid pack problems, and it is sensitive to using the correct fluid.
issues.next: Have the codes read and the fluid checked, using only the fluid type the manufacturer specifies. If it slips badly or will not engage, stop driving to avoid destroying the transmission.

issues.t: Front lower control arm bolt can break (recall)
issues.sym: Clunking from the front end, wandering steering, or a wheel that looks out of line.
issues.why: A pivot bolt on the front lower control arm could fracture. Chrysler recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls. If the front end clunks or the steering pulls suddenly, stop driving and have it towed.

issues.t: Water can drip into the radio and short it (recall)
issues.sym: Radio cuts out, a burning smell from the dash, or smoke from the speakers or radio.
issues.why: Condensation from the A/C system could drip onto the radio, causing a short that could start a fire. Chrysler recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls. If you smell burning from the dash, pull over and turn the van off.

issues.t: Rear A/C evaporator and lines corrode and leak
issues.sym: Rear A/C blows warm, hissing from the rear, or the system loses refrigerant again after a recharge.
issues.why: The rear evaporator core and the long refrigerant lines running under the van corrode and develop slow leaks.
issues.next: Have the system leak-tested before paying for a recharge. Repairs usually mean replacing the rear evaporator or the corroded lines.

issues.t: Fuel tank control valve can leak (recall)
issues.sym: Fuel smell near the rear of the van, especially after filling up.
issues.why: A weld on the fuel tank control valve could separate and leak fuel. Chrysler recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls. Do not drive with a fuel smell until it is inspected.

issues.t: Power steering cooler hose can split (recall)
issues.sym: Power steering fluid under the front of the van, whining steering, or steering that suddenly gets heavy.
issues.why: The hose to the power steering fluid cooler could split, losing fluid onto hot engine parts. Chrysler recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls. If the steering gets heavy or you see fluid spraying, stop driving and have it repaired.

issues.t: Windshield wiper motor shaft can break (recall)
issues.sym: Wipers stop moving or flop loose on the glass.
issues.why: The armature shaft inside the wiper motor could break. Chrysler recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and have the motor replaced before driving in rain or snow.

issues.t: Front crash sensors can crack and fail (recall)
issues.sym: Airbag warning light on the dash.
issues.why: The front impact sensors could crack and let water in, which can stop them from signaling the airbags. Chrysler recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and have the sensors replaced promptly.

issues.t: Airbag control module can get wet and fail (recalls)
issues.sym: Airbag warning light on, or in rare cases an airbag going off without a crash.
issues.why: A/C condensate and a leaky drain grommet could let water reach the airbag control module, and the module could corrode. Chrysler ran several recalls on these vans.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls. If water collects in the front footwells or the airbag light is on, get it checked right away.

issues.t: Sliding door wiring can chafe and short (recall)
issues.sym: Sliding door electrics act up, blown fuses, or a burning smell near the sliding door.
issues.why: The wiring harness at the sliding door hinge could wear through its insulation and short, creating a fire risk. Chrysler recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls. If you smell burning near the door, stop and have it inspected.

issues.t: Ignition key can slip out of Run and shut the van off (recall)
issues.sym: Engine suddenly shuts off while driving, often after the key ring is bumped, and power steering and brake assist are lost.
issues.why: The ignition switch could move from Run to Accessory or Off while driving, which also can keep the airbags from deploying. Chrysler recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls. Use a light key ring and do not drive the van until the recall repair is done.

issues.t: Steering wheel emblem can come loose in an airbag deployment (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no symptom, though the horn pad emblem may feel loose.
issues.why: The brand emblem on the steering wheel could detach and be thrown when the driver airbag deploys. Chrysler recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and have the emblem secured or replaced.

issues.t: Plastic coolant pipe leak
issues.sym: Coolant smell, small puddles, steam from the back of the engine, or a slowly falling coolant level.
issues.why: A plastic Y-shaped coolant pipe that sits above the exhaust manifold gets brittle from heat and cracks.
issues.next: Keep an eye on the coolant level and have the pipe replaced when it seeps. Stop driving if the temperature gauge climbs.

issues.t: Brakes wear out early and rotors warp
issues.sym: Grinding or squealing, a shaking steering wheel or pedal when braking, or a hot brake smell.
issues.why: Vans from these years used smaller brakes for their weight, so pads and rotors wear and overheat sooner. Larger brakes became standard later.
issues.next: Have the brakes inspected more often than on a typical car and replace pads and rotors as a set.

issues.t: Integrated power module (TIPM) failure
issues.sym: No-start or intermittent start, stalling, a fuel pump that keeps running with the key off, random horn or wiper activity, or a battery that drains overnight.
issues.why: The under-hood power module, which controls the fuel pump relay and many other circuits, can fail internally. Federal regulators opened an investigation into these failures.
issues.next: Have the module diagnosed before replacing other parts. A van that stalls in traffic should not be driven until it is fixed.

issues.t: Vent window switch can overheat (recall)
issues.sym: Hot or melted switch on the driver door armrest, burning smell, or smoke from the door.
issues.why: The power vent window switch could overheat, especially if liquid got into it, and start a fire. Chrysler recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls. Avoid spilling drinks on the door switches and stop if you smell burning.

issues.t: Steering column rivet may be missing (recall)
issues.sym: Steering wheel feels loose or moves in an unusual way.
issues.why: A pivot rivet in the steering column may be missing or installed wrong, which could affect steering control. Chrysler recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls. If the steering wheel feels loose, stop driving and have it towed.

issues.t: Driver airbag can deploy on its own (recall)
issues.sym: Airbag warning light, or the driver airbag deploying without a crash.
issues.why: A wiring harness under the steering column could chafe and short, which may set off the driver airbag. Chrysler recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and have the repair done as soon as possible.

issues.t: Left cylinder head failure and misfires
issues.sym: Check engine light, misfire codes on the driver-side bank, rough idle and a ticking noise.
issues.why: A defect in the left cylinder head can cause cylinders on that side to misfire. Chrysler extended warranty coverage on affected engines instead of issuing a recall.
issues.next: Ask a dealer whether your VIN falls under the extended coverage before paying for repairs.

issues.t: Ticking from worn rocker arms
issues.sym: A ticking or chirping from the top of the engine that speeds up with RPM, sometimes with misfires and a check engine light.
issues.why: Rocker arm rollers can wear and in turn damage the camshaft.
issues.next: Have the noise checked early. Replacing rockers before cam damage happens keeps the repair smaller.

issues.t: Oil filter housing leak
issues.sym: Oil in the valley at the top of the engine, a burning oil smell, low oil level, or coolant mixing with oil.
issues.why: The plastic oil filter and cooler housing can crack or its gaskets can harden over time.
issues.next: Have the housing replaced when leaks appear, and do not ignore a falling coolant or oil level.

issues.t: Connecting rod bearing can fail from debris (recall)
issues.sym: Knocking from inside the engine, low oil pressure light, or the engine seizing.
issues.why: Machining debris left in some engine blocks could damage a connecting rod bearing. Chrysler recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls. If the engine knocks, stop driving to avoid destroying it.

issues.t: Right rear wheel hub may not be fully machined (recall)
issues.sym: Grinding, wobble or vibration from the right rear wheel.
issues.why: Some right rear hub and bearing assemblies were not fully machined, which could let the wheel come loose. Chrysler recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls. Any new wheel noise or wobble means stop and have it inspected.

issues.t: Power liftgate may not reverse on an obstruction (recall)
issues.sym: The power liftgate keeps closing when it touches something on the right side.
issues.why: The right-side pinch sensor on the power liftgate might not work properly. Chrysler recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and keep people clear of the liftgate while it closes.

issues.t: Airbag software errors (recalls)
issues.sym: Usually no symptom; the risk is how the airbags respond in a crash.
issues.why: Software errors in the airbag control module could deploy airbags on the wrong side or affect deployment. Chrysler recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and have the software updated promptly.

issues.t: Tire pressure warning may not alert (recall)
issues.sym: No low tire warning even when a tire is low.
issues.why: A software error in the tire pressure monitoring system could keep the low-pressure warning from showing. Chrysler recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and check tire pressures by hand until it is updated.

issues.t: Windshield may not stay in place in a crash (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no symptom, though a poorly bonded windshield may leak or creak.
issues.why: Some windshields were installed with expired primer and might not stay bonded in a crash. Chrysler recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and have the windshield reinstalled if your van is listed.

issues.t: Transmission pump can seize (recall)
issues.sym: Sudden loss of drive, the van will not move, or warning lights with a transmission fault.
issues.why: The transmission oil pump could seize and lose hydraulic pressure, which leaves the van without drive. Chrysler recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls. If the transmission stops pulling, get off the road safely and have it towed.

issues.t: Hood latch striker bolts can loosen (recall)
issues.sym: Hood rattles or the hood looks raised at one corner.
issues.why: Bolts holding the hood striker could loosen, letting the hood open while driving. Chrysler recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls. If the hood rattles or will not stay latched, do not drive the van.

issues.t: Third-row seatback nuts may loosen (recall)
issues.sym: Third-row seatback feels loose or rattles.
issues.why: Nuts holding the third-row seatback were not torqued properly and could loosen. Chrysler recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and keep passengers out of a loose third-row seat until it is repaired.

issues.t: Engine computer can fail and stall the van (recall)
issues.sym: Engine stalls while driving or will not start.
issues.why: A chip in the powertrain control module could fail. Chrysler recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls. Do not rely on the van in traffic until the repair is done.

issues.t: Rear brake calipers may reduce braking (recall)
issues.sym: Weaker braking or a softer brake pedal.
issues.why: A coating problem on the rear brake calipers could form gas pockets and reduce braking performance. Chrysler recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls. If braking feels weak, stop driving and have it inspected.

issues.t: Second- and third-row seat latches may fail in a crash (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no symptom, though a seat may rattle or feel loose when latched.
issues.why: Welds on the seat striker plates for the second and third rows may not hold in a crash. Chrysler recalled affected vans.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and have the strikers inspected promptly.
